accepted.message: Overly permissive mask in chmod sets file to group readable.
accepted.reason: PRIVILEGE.md requires the config repository to be root-owned, group-readable by the production config group and never group-writable. The reset writes that tree, so 0o640 root:group is the prescribed mode; anything tighter locks the worker out of the tree it must read.

accepted.message: Overly permissive mask in chmod sets file to group readable.
accepted.reason: Published releases are read by the nodes as the publish group, which is why _group_id fails closed when that group is missing. 0o640 root:group is the documented mode for a release tree; removing group read would silently break deployment.

accepted.message: Overly permissive mask in open sets file to group readable.
accepted.reason: Same release tree, same group: the staged files are created with the mode they will keep, so the open and the later chmod agree rather than leaving a window at a different mode.
